name: star-harness
description: Thin Agent Team integration for Kimi Code.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate autonomous Agent Teams and durable Work.
interface.longDescription: Adds provider-neutral Member skills, lifecycle status hooks, CLI shortcuts, and Dashboard deep links. Agent coordination uses the firm CLI; provider execution remains in native sessions.

skillInstructions: Use the Harness CLI as the complete path. Agent Team Works store responsibility, status, submission, and Host acceptance; correlated Messages carry conversation and provider questions. Members may use provider-native subagents internally; AgentSession permission is frozen before start, and provider-native sessions remain execution truth.
